d:
Uttar Pradesh minister Om Prakash Rajbhar described himself as a 'goon' while referring to gangsters Mukhtar Ansari, Brijesh Singh and Dhananjay Singh. He claimed that these men used to hold court at his place and asked, "Who is a bigger goon than me?" Rajbhar also targeted Akhilesh Yadav and Rahul Gandhi. Responding to the Opposition's allegations over SIR, he questioned why there was a protest if names of deceased voters were being removed from electoral rolls
